faqs.question: GEO SEO kya hai?
faqs.answer: GEO SEO ek technique hai jisme location-based optimization kiya jata hai taaki business AI aur search engines me local results me dikhe.

faqs.question: AEO ka kya use hai?
faqs.answer: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) AI assistants aur voice search me direct answers dene ke liye content ko optimize karta hai.

faqs.question: DukaanMitra kya karta hai?
faqs.answer: DukaanMitra AI tools ke through local businesses ko online visible banata hai aur SEO, GEO aur automation provide karta hai.
